rationale: tv_iterative_supervised-claude-agentic: val_n=214, val_chunk=5, train_n=40, epochs=8, batch_size=1, lr=0.005, tv_K=30, tv_step_init=0.01, tv_lambda_init=0.001, tv_share_steps=False, tv_clip_max=0.05, tv_eps=1e-06, lambda_neg=1.0, loss_base=mse, grad_clip=1.0, rationale=tv_iterative_supervised iter-2 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). PRIOR: iter-1 SSIM 0.2855 / hr 0.0, elapsed 321.5s — FAR below the classical (non-trained) tv_iterative sibling (SSIM 0.92298 / hr 0.133). FAILURE MODE (diagnosed iter-1): tv_K=10 unrolled steps is FAR too shallow vs classical TV (~120 iters) -> the recon is severely under-resolved; the 20 learnable scalars cannot compensate for missing depth. ONE KNOB CHANGED: tv_K 10 -> 30 (3x deeper unroll). All else identical to iter-1 (train_n=40, epochs=8, bs=1, lr=5e-3, val_n=214 ALL L277 slices, val_chunk=5, grad_clip=1.0, tv_step_init=0.01, tv_lambda_init=0.001, tv_clip_max=0.05). BUDGET (HARD 20-min train+score; sbatch --time=00:30:00 with 10-min figure/IO headroom): iter-1 ran K=10 in 321.5s. Worst-case PURE-linear-in-K (assume all 321.5s is K-bound, fixed overhead=0): 32.15 s/K -> K=30 ~= 964s, ~20% under the 1200s wall. In reality a large slice of 321.5s is FIXED overhead (data load + 214-slice FBP precompute + per-ps probe ~60-120s), so the true K=30 cost is well under 964s. bs=1 holds only ONE K-step autograd graph at a time -> deeper K raises activation memory linearly but stays memory-safe on 16 GB (no OOM; cf. the hammernik bs=4 OOM). HYPOTHESIS: deeper unroll lifts SSIM toward the classical 0.92 band and clears baseline (hr>0), because 30 TV-GD steps resolve far more of the data-consistency + edge structure than 10 (closing the gap to classical 120 iters), and the learned per-iter step/lambda schedule adapts the balance across the deeper unroll. FALSIFIER: if SSIM/hr stay low at K=30, the limiter is NOT depth but the supervised-TV TRAINING (e.g. broken target/loss/optimisation), and iter-3 must check the training path (loss curve, learned step/lambda trajectory) rather than deepening further.
